answer: A farm of 43 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are entered in opal, queued in willow, and beacon publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 35 identities per epoch. A farm of 1422 identities would post 4089 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
